notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
[p]The cats meow again! 

I've got reports from multiple people that the cats would sometimes stop meowing. I did find this was the case with: New Delhi, Barcelona & Atlantis. These levels are now fixed. Should you encounter more cats remaining silent, please take extra care of them and forward me their name & location. :)

Peace & Love, [/p][p]Patrick[/p]
